notes: All inputs copied once with read-only VACUUM INTO, then copied afresh per case and phase. Every Bun case runs in a new process with private HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, LLV_STATE_DIR, TMPDIR and CODEX_HOME; the Viewer control URL points at a closed port.

The raw audit timer includes heapStats before and after the call. The occupancy replay moves only the timer reset after pre-call inspection and the captured timer result before post-call inspection; helperBeforeMs and helperAfterMs expose their costs.
H8 and D6 readiness runs roleTarget first, warming project views. role-projects includes first reads and memo hits separately. Baseline and candidate use the same dependency graph and Bun 1.4.0.
Each original scalar case has six repetitions; role-projects has eight (four projects twice); profile-view has two independent processes. Occupancy has six repetitions per case and phase.
A warm profile shorter than the 1 ms sampling interval cannot identify the remaining sub-millisecond work. The timed view and its synchronous span provide that evidence.
